scope: Scientific record consistency, separate from the active native calibration capsule

sections.measured: Actual native TCP, BASE, fingers and object state, measured TCP velocity, original event flags and installed-reference tracking error. Missing values are null with false masks.
sections.innovation: Actual response minus an immutable prediction saved before the first effect, at the exact declared native target step, conditioned on the complete actual command chain. Tracking error is not innovation.
sections.forecast: Separate candidate-conditioned estimates. Full-preview certificate, current-state identity, external model-domain qualification and calibration references are checked for consistency. These records authorize no execution.

command_domains.UPSTREAM_INSTALLED_REFERENCE: Original accept/install ACK, exact wire bytes, full decoded H40 and BASE, complete 25-tick window, original source clock/TTL and actual owned-child gripper consumption.
command_domains.SOLVER_TARGET_CONFIRMED: Additional join from each solver target hash and send time to raw installed receiver events for the same reference, including rolling targets.
command_domains.CONTROLLER_SELECTED_POLICY: Not exported by the present executor; remains DERIVED/unknown with a separate false mask. Solver confirmation is not selected-WBC-policy proof.
command_domains.upstream_conditioned_innovation: Can be valid with a complete upstream command/response chain while hidden controller selection remains unknown. A solver-conditioned model additionally needs solver-domain evidence.

causal_checks: Same run, native spec, executor, scene, frame and TCP semantics
Pinned prediction bytes plus a post-fsync receipt ordered before original first-effect trace time
Exact issue/history/target native clocks; no nearest-frame or future-frame substitution
Every actual atom matches its planned global index, full effective H40 suffix, source subatom phase, fixed BASE and held gripper command
Actual state document chain and same original gripper child/library with contiguous sequence numbers
Same-program wire renewal is allowed with matching content and clock evidence
Command/reference change, cancel, TTL expiry, reset, takeover, partial interval, STOP, HOLD or unknown lifecycle event masks old innovation

authentication_boundary.required_external_verification: The caller must authenticate original producer/source identity, raw packet and file pins, prediction persistence, trace timing, complete lifecycle/command records, history inputs and model-domain/calibration receipts. This pure assembler does not read or authenticate those files or manufacture missing receipts.
authentication_boundary.actual_state_hash: Canonical measured-state document SHA; explicitly not the raw state.bin or file SHA
authentication_boundary.old_predictions_without_required_evidenc: Innovation remains masked false; no legacy prediction or weak local WM is automatically upgraded

information_boundary.native_simulator_state: Privileged simulator information, not qualified RGB deployment input
information_boundary.forecast: Conditional model estimate, not a measurement, current proprioception, command or expert label
information_boundary.uncertainty: Availability and calibration-reference masks are distinct; the packet does not establish empirical calibration

validation.interpreter: Project native CI Python; machine-specific executable path remains private

optimized.warning: Expected pytest notice about Python -O assertions outside rewritten test modules

validation.fixture_scope: Hermetic synthetic records; passing fixtures are not native or model qualification
meaningful_negative_cases: Unrelated solver target and wrong send time
Changed full H40 lookahead or source phase under the same claimed program ID
Missing receiver ACK, wrong wire/state/target/gripper proof and expired reference
Late prediction save, wrong target/history/restart, missing atom and lifecycle discontinuities
Held old gripper sequence and changed actual child
Unknown WM domain, wrong candidate state/full preview, incomplete certificate and uncalibrated uncertainty/events
Missing measured values remain masked instead of being filled by forecast
validation.assembly_artifact_reads_or_process_spawn: Forbidden by a passing hermetic test
